thread:
marie: Customer reported a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. They sent an SDK-wrapped payload — customer says their mobile SDK double-encodes the JSON. Repro on staging with their sample.

marie: Response from our gateway: 400 Bad Request - "invalid request: items must be a non-empty array". Customer insists items were present.

tom: Can you paste the raw request body they actually sent (the HTTP body), and the exact response body from our API? Also which SDK + version and platform?

marie: They gave this as the HTTP body (copied verbatim from their network trace):
```json
{"envelope":"{\"items\":[],\"candidates\":\"[\\\"opt1\\\",\\\"opt2\\\"]\",\"top_k\":null,\"scores\":null}"}
```
marie: And our response: 
```json
{\"error\":\"invalid request: items must be a non-empty array\",\"status\":400}
```

tom: Ah, looks like the SDK wrapped the payload in an outer object and then stringified the inner JSON into the "envelope" field. So our parser sees envelope as a string (not parsed JSON), then the inner "items" becomes an empty array *inside the string*, and candidates are a stringified array (not a proper array), top_k is null (allowed but we prefer integer), scores null -> types mismatch. This matches a double-encoding bug in older mobile SDKs.

tom: Quick repro steps for eng:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"envelope":"{\"items\":[],\"candidates\":\"[\\\"a\\\"]\"}'}'
2) observe 400 with same error.
ingest-bot: gateway-log: parse_error at request_id=rx-9f2a, handler=rerank, reason=invalid_items_type, raw_body_size=512

marie: Customer SDK: mobile-sdk-android v0.9.1 (they upgraded from 0.9.0 last week). They send data via our helper that by default wraps payloads for telemetry; looks like it calls JSON.stringify twice in some paths.

tom: Short-term workaround: ask customer to send raw JSON body (disable sdk wrapper) or switch to our raw request API: set header X-Redwood-SDK-Raw: 1. We will patch gateway to detect stringified JSON in known wrapper keys (envelope, payload, request) and attempt best-effort parse with a debug warning, but not silently accept — we should log and continue only in non-prod.

clara: Filed support ticket RED-3421 with attachments (network trace, stacktrace). Assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

marie: I'll reply to the customer with repro steps and the temporary header workaround. Will ask them to attach a raw HAR.

tom: For follow-up: add a validation message that lists which fields had wrong types (candidates should be array, items non-empty array, scores if present should be array of numbers). Also add an integration test for SDK wrapping.

marie: Thanks — ping me if you want the staging request id to look up logs. :thumbsup:
